info.title: Icod.TermInfo Tools
info.description: Installable .NET tool router for the managed Icod.TermInfo tic, infocmp, toe, captoinfo, and infotocap commands.

commands.name: infocmp
commands.description: render and semantically compare terminal descriptions

options.name: -x
options.description: allow required local extended declarations/cancellations

options.name: --json
options.description: emit one stable machine-readable inspection, comparison, or plan document

options.name: -D
options.description: print Runtime database discovery locations and exit

options.name: --version
options.description: print the Icod.TermInfo tool-suite version and exit

options.name: --help
options.description:
display this help and exit
Sort keys: d=compiled-table order, i=terminfo short name, l=long variable name, c=termcap code.
Without -x, relative synthesis fails if reproducing the target requires local extended directives.
The -n universe is the closed standard capability catalog even when -x is supplied.
Unambiguous short options may be clustered; -A, -B, -w, and -s accept attached values; use -- before a terminal name beginning with '-'.
Relative use= references preserve parent operand spelling and order; -B applies to every parent or planning candidate.
Planning writes only the selected source to stdout. Comparison selectors, -u, -q, and -D cannot be combined with --plan-use.
All-candidates planning requires --plan-use, exactly one target, and one explicit -B conventional directory; it never performs host discovery.
Successful JSON output is one document followed by exactly one LF.

options.name: -A
options.description: use this explicit database for the first terminal

options.name: -B
options.description: use this explicit database for subsequent terminals
emit one logical source line without wrapping
emit one capability per line without continuation wrapping

options.name: -w
options.description: request canonical string-capability wrapping width

options.name: -s
options.description: order standard capabilities by d, i, l, or c

options.name: -u
options.description:
rewrite target relative to each ordered parent using use=
-c -u           accepted as an ncurses-compatible synonym for -u

options.name: --plan-use
options.description: select ordered use= parents from explicit candidates

options.name: --all-candidates
options.description: use every canonical entry from the one explicit -B directory

options.name: --max-parents
options.description: limit selected ordered parents; default 2

options.name: --max-plans
options.description: limit evaluated plans; default 4097

options.name: --allow-bounded
options.description: return the best deterministic evaluated prefix

options.name: -d
options.description: list semantic differences; default for two or more operands

options.name: -c
options.description: list capabilities with common effective values

options.name: -n
options.description: list standard capabilities absent from all compared entries

options.name: -q
options.description: use shorter comparison presentation

options.name: -c

options.name: -e
options.description: process only selected canonical names or aliases

options.name: -x

options.name: -s

commands.name: toe
commands.description:
enumerate databases and analyze use= dependencies
captoinfo convert termcap descriptions to effective terminfo source
infotocap convert effective terminfo source to termcap descriptions

options.name: -a
options.description: inspect all discovered conventional databases

options.name: -h
options.description: write a heading naming each inspected database

options.name: -s
options.description: sort entries by canonical terminal name; with -a, mark semantic duplicates

options.name: --json
options.description: inspect exactly one explicit directory and emit its databaseCatalog document

options.name: -u
options.description: list forward use= dependencies in source order

options.name: -U
options.description: list reverse use= dependencies deterministically

options.name: -D
options.description: print Runtime database discovery locations and exit

options.name: --version
options.description: print version information and exit

options.name: --help
options.description:
display this help and exit
Unambiguous listing options may be clustered; -u/-U accept attached source paths; use -- before a directory or source filename beginning with '-'.
JSON mode rejects listing presentation switches and writes one document followed by exactly one LF.
